summary:
A browser-based game where you design a real Mars mission. Allocate a budget across six systems — propulsion, power, life support, and more — then watch your choices play out across launch, surface operations, and return. Every outcome is explained using actual NASA data, so you're not just playing; you're learning how mission design actually works—no install needed. Finish a full mission in under five minutes.

MISSION: Prepare for humanity's journey to Mars, but reaching there is only the start of the disaster! You'll make important decisions, manage limited resources, and manage unexpected challenges along this journey.
You are given 100 billion dollars ($) to distribute across six important criteria systems. Every decision counts, so be cautious about where your resources go!
Make your decisions wisely. Your crew is counting on you... or don't. Well, it's your mission.
